<!--

-->

Based on
- https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/pull/4228

Update AWS Lambda invocation IDs to the proposed `faas.invocation.id` key for 3.0. This is a telemetry breaking change: the legacy key is no longer emitted, with no compatibility alias.

- **Emission:** Rename the key in the shared Lambda extractor used by core, API Gateway, and SQS paths; keep the AWS request ID value unchanged.
- **Coverage and metadata:** Update assertions to verify the new wire key and refresh the Lambda metadata description. No `faas.time` emitter exists, so no timestamp is added.

```diff
- "faas.invocation_id": "..."
+ "faas.invocation.id": "..."
```
metadata.title: Rename AWS Lambda invocation ID attribute
